name: Level_2 - Task_9
description:
Investigate how temporal correlation and temperature shifts affect a global SOAP–Ridge model of copper potential energy. Use the supplied periodic 32-atom copper cell and MACE-MP-0 teacher. Generate a main 800 K trajectory and three independent trajectories at 800, 500, and 1100 K. Start each run from the original supplied cell with a distinct recorded velocity seed, initialize velocities at its target temperature, and remove center-of-mass momentum. Keep the cell fixed and continue directly from equilibration into production without replacing atoms or reinitializing velocities.

Choose and justify the integration, thermostat, equilibration, production, and sampling settings. Retain 200 chronological production frames per run, giving 800 labeled structures in total. Obtain total potential-energy labels from the supplied teacher and compute one global SOAP descriptor per structure; descriptor settings, scaling, and Ridge regularization are yours to choose. Quantify temporal dependence of the main trajectory's energies using a justified estimator. Report its curve, a characteristic correlation time or supported bound with time units, and limitations imposed by sampling and trajectory length. Check equilibration and measured production temperatures for all four runs.

Compare randomized-split validation with a justified time-aware validation strategy on the main trajectory. Use only that trajectory for model selection; fit preprocessing exclusively on each training partition and protect evaluation holdouts, including the randomized holdout, from hyperparameter selection. Compare strategies at comparable training and evaluation sample budgets, or explain the resulting limitations. Document splits, tuning, and selection criteria. Freeze a final structure-to-prediction pipeline trained on the main trajectory before evaluating the three independent trajectories. Report MAE and RMSE in eV and dimensionless R² for both validation strategies and each independent test. Interpret temporal dependence and temperature transfer and support conclusions with evidence; no metric ordering or minimum R² is required.

Submit the manifest below with the complete trained pipeline, descriptor configuration, inference script, split indices, tuning results, correlation analysis, and aligned trajectories, energy labels, descriptors, and predictions. Save physical times, cell, positions, momenta, energies, and forces for retained frames, plus restartable equilibration/production boundary states and raw simulation logs. Include enough settings and evidence to reproduce predictions and verify preparation, continuity, sampling, temperatures, and reported metrics.
submission_format:
Fill in the blank manifest below and submit its path inside the task workspace
(for example, output/manifest.json). Linked paths may be relative to the manifest.
Replace null, empty strings and arrays with your results, file paths and data;
repeat example records and replace <...> keys with your actual identifiers.
Fixed units and method names describe the illustrated format. Where the task
leaves a method open, choose and record your method. Retain raw evidence and
calculations for any alternative method; unsupported calculations require
independent review before a final score.
